topics.description: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme is a large-scale investigation into the alleged defrauding of the government of $250 million. Two defendants have pleaded guilty, while one has rejected a plea deal. This case is significant as it highlights the need for increased oversight and accountability in government programs.
topics.reason: Recent guilty pleas and ongoing investigation

topics.topic: FBI investigations into Trump administration officials
topics.description: The FBI is currently investigating several Trump administration officials, including Joe Kent, for allegedly sharing classified information. This trend is significant as it highlights the need for increased transparency and accountability in government.
